module: Flowgraph node "Debug Prism" (category repeat_instant, tags util/draw). Draws a square/rectangular-base prism (debugDrawer:drawSquarePrism) between posA and posB every frame, with a width and a height at each end. Inputs: posA, posB (vec3 required), widthA, heightA, widthB, heightB (number, 1 by default), color (hidden, pink by default).
notes: The code builds Point2F(height, width): the order passed to the engine is (height, width).

work.desc: If posA and posB are set, draws the prism.
